quote: Suoritettava vero on 25,5 prosenttia veron perusteesta, ellei 85 tai 85 a §:ssä toisin säädetä. — The tax payable is 25.5% of the taxable amount unless sections 85 or 85a provide otherwise.
source_title: Finlex — Arvonlisäverolaki 1501/1993, ajantasaistettu (consolidated), change log: 'Muutosta 462/2024 … muutt. 84 ja 85 b § 1.9.2024'

reduced_rates.scope: food, restaurant and catering, animal feed, passenger transport, accommodation, medicines, sanitary/incontinence products and nappies, books, sport and cultural admissions, performers' fees, works of art, copyright fees (85 §; 14%→13.5% from 2026-01-01 by L 1358/2025; categories moved from 10% on 2025-01-01 by L 691/2024)
newspapers and periodicals, physical or electronic (85 a §)
exports, intra-EU supplies and certain other zero-rated supplies

notes: Finlex change log lists later amendments (585/2026 from 14.7.2026, 597/2026 from 1.1.2027, 25/2026 from 1.7.2027), none of which amend 84, 85 or 85 a §. TEDB cross-check: 25.5% standard; 13.5% and 10% reduced — consistent.
